#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#define INF 17446744073709551616ULL
#define ULL unsigned long long
using namespace std;

ULL mod, n, k, dp[18][250005];
ULL factorial[250005], inv_factorial[250005];

ULL fast_pow(ULL base, ULL exponent) {
    ULL result = 1ULL;
    ULL current = base;
    while (exponent > 0) {
        if (exponent & 1ULL) {
            result *= current;
            result %= mod;
        }
        current *= current;
        current %= mod;
        exponent >>= 1ULL;
    }
    return result;
}

ULL combination(int a, int b) {
    return (((factorial[a] * inv_factorial[b]) % mod) * inv_factorial[a - b]) % mod;
}

ULL compute() {
    int i, j, l;
    factorial[0] = 1ULL;
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        factorial[i] = factorial[i - 1] * ((ULL)i) % mod;
    }
    inv_factorial[n] = fast_pow(factorial[n], mod - 2ULL);
    for (i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        inv_factorial[i] = inv_factorial[i + 1] * ((ULL)(i + 1)) % mod;
    }
    for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        dp[1][i] = inv_factorial[i];
    }
    ULL answer = dp[1][n] * combination(k, 1) % mod;
    int limit = min(17, (int)k);
    for (i = 2; i <= limit; i++) {
        for (j = n; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & n) {
            if (dp[i - 1][j] == 0) continue;
            int remaining = n ^ j;
            for (l = remaining; l > 0; l = (l - 1) & remaining) {
                dp[i][j + l] += dp[i - 1][j] * inv_factorial[l];
                if (dp[i][j + l] > INF) dp[i][j + l] %= mod;
            }
        }
        for (j = n; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & n) {
            dp[i][j] %= mod;
        }
        answer += dp[i][n] * combination(k, i);
        answer %= mod;
    }
    answer *= factorial[n];
    answer %= mod;
    return answer;
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> k >> mod;
    ULL result = fast_pow(k, n);
    if (n % 2 == 0) {
        result = (result - compute() + mod) % mod;
    }
    cout << result << endl;
    return 0;
}
